notes: Title/subtitle: 1.0625/1.25Gbps, 32dB power budget, 120km, C-temp and I-temp. Power budget 15–32dB (w/o optical path penalties per definitions). Dispersion penalty max 1dB. Operating temperature also -40°C to +85°C for I-temp variant (SO-SFP-1000Base-EZXD-I). Storage temperature -40°C to +85°C. Transmitter/receiver power specs are average power (footnote 1). Minimum input power and overload (footnote 2): @ 1.25Gbps, BER ≤ 1×10^-12, PRBS 27-1, back-to-back. Transmission media stated as SM (2x LC). Nominal wavelength Tx/Rx: 1× 1550nm.
suggestions: Consider list[float] for temp_min_c/temp_max_c when multiple temperature grades (C-temp vs I-temp) apply to different orderable SKUs. Power budget 15–32dB may warrant dedicated schema fields separate from insertion loss.
